reviews.text:
Thank you Julian for a 5 star review. We really appreciate the positive feedback!

Kind regards,
Deerpark Vets Team

Lady at reception was very friendly
The vet Brendan also very friendly interested in cat and helpful

Brendan and Ella were so attentive and knowledgeable on examination and treatment of our dogs, explaining each step clearly and all options available.  I would thoroughly recommend this personalised service which puts the best interest of our pets at its centre.

I can’t recommend Deerpark Vets highly enough. Brendan was just fantastic and so helpful when I brought my brand new puppy this morning. No question was too much trouble and he gave me as much time as I needed. He was so kind to my new Golden.

Brendan at Deerpark Vets is exactly what you want in a Vet, knowledgeable, highly competent, very kind and empathetic. At a routine vaccine visit Brendan spotted that all was not well with our beloved ragdoll cat, even though we had missed the signs at home. He spent time with us to work out an appropriate treatment plan to support our cat as he enters his final phase, and stays in regular contact to monitor his progress. Brendan's approach and support is very reassuring.

We are so impressed by Brendan from Deerpark Vets.  He has shown exceptional care and sensitivity for our beloved dog Féile and for ourselves at a very difficult time.  His dedication and generosity with his time, including outside normal hours, was unbelievable.   His constant focus was on Féile's welfare and he listened to all our concerns carefully and provided very clear and detailed information.  We are so grateful to him.  I would happily give more than five stars if this were possible.
Absolutely the best vet ever. My dogs love Brendan, and a trip to him is like a trip to the park 😄
Brought our dog Gordo to see Brendan today after he had surgery and he was fantastic! Really put us at ease and was brilliant with Gordo.  Highly recommend him best vet we have ever dealt with.

We are very grateful to Dr Brendan at Deerpark Vets for his professionalism, patience and thorough care. Our puppy was only two months old when we brought him home, and we knew very little about how to care for and feed him. As our English is not very good, Dr Brendan kindly slowed down and explained everything step by step, answering each of our questions carefully. He was also exceptionally gentle and caring with our puppy. We would highly recommend Dr Brendan and Deerpark Vets.

The moment we walked through the door with Alfie, we knew we had found the right vets for him.

Brendan and Ella were absolutely brilliant. Ella came straight over to Alfie, gave him such a lovely welcome and made him feel completely at ease. You could immediately see how genuine their love and care for animals is.

Brendan was so thorough with Alfie’s issue and, in the process, discovered an ear problem that we didn’t even know he had. We’re so grateful he picked it up, as we can now manage it properly and keep Alfie comfortable.

What really touched us was that they took the time to follow up with us before our next appointment just to see how Alfie was doing. That extra bit of care meant so much to us.

It’s so reassuring knowing your dog is in the hands of people who genuinely care. Alfie is such an important part of our family, and we couldn’t be happier that we found such a lovely team to look after him.

Thank you Brendan and Ella for looking after our boy so amazingly 🐾❤️

Alfie gives you five stars… although he’d probably give you six if you didn’t give him a cone ! 🐶⭐️
